Publish.LongDescription:
### Parks, Roads + Lane Wear
Adjust each feature independently. Every slider starts at 100%, the game default.
- Park maintenance: depot fleet size, vehicle work capacity, and work rate. - Road maintenance: depot fleet size, vehicle work capacity, and repair rate. - Lane wear: change how quickly road lanes deteriorate from time and traffic.
Settings can be changed while a city is loaded. The About tab provides a one-time report for checking the current prefab values.
This is a separate mod. All Transit + Trucks is not required.
